brief.goal: Deliver an external, zoom-aware selection indicator and hover preview so the chosen cell's color is never hidden. The selection indicator must be drawn outside the chosen cell's interior (offset and scaled with the camera transform) rather than as an inward border/inset shadow over it, and must remain legible and correctly positioned at fit-to-wall zoom, at paint zoom, and on the 390 px mobile layout. Hovering or selecting a cell must preview the currently selected palette color in a separate preview layer that is visually distinct from confirmed art and from pending paint, never covering a confirmed cell's color. Add unit tests asserting the indicator geometry has zero overlap with the chosen cell's interior and that the preview layer is not part of the confirmed-pixel layer. Preserve the merged zoom/pan camera transform contract and the toolbar layout from head commit 245f9c7; no contract, palette, wallet, or deployment edits.
